newsitem.title: USA: TVA Browns Ferry, Ala., nuclear plant boosts power.
newsitem.headline: TVA Browns Ferry, Ala., nuclear plant boosts power.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's (TVA) 1,065 megawatt Browns Ferry nuclear power unit 3 was expected to hold at near 24 percent of capacity Tuesday for continued testing after an outage which began September 4, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"We will be staying at that (29 percent) level until they make any maintenance checks necessary," TVA spokesman Gil Francis said.
The Decatur, Ala., unit was taken off line last Wednesday for maintenance, Francis said, adding he could not be more specific about the nature of that maintenance.
The spokesman would not estimate when the unit would return to full service.
"We don't say when (any of) those plants are going back to full because we have to go through this maintenance check process," Francis said.
